owner_and_capability: The legacy composition (legacy-composition: services) stops importing owner application, domain and platform packages: it names the retained services of Activities, Facilities, Device Fleet, Staff Clock, Data Import, Audit Platform, Settings Platform, Communication, Document Rendering and Transaction Runtime through their compositions or contracts, and the records and keys of models/{config,platform,audit,users} through the vocabulary packages of Settings Platform, Organization & Tenancy, Audit Platform and People Directory. Mail and live events come through Delivery (modules/delivery/compose/{email,realtime}), calendar dates through sharedkernel/calendar, the missing-row sentinel through modules/transactionruntime; the root (root-composition: api) builds the analytics tracker. Policy epoch 38 per ADR 0050.
affected_tables: None: code-only composition change, no database tables or DDL affected.
atomic_cutover: One reviewed epoch (37 -> 38, ADR 0050). serviceFactoryCutoverPermission (internal/architecture/service_factory_cutover.go), anchored on the base classifying services as legacy-composition/compose, grants exactly five production pairs between points that exist at the base: legacy-composition/compose -> document-rendering/contract and -> transaction-runtime/public, data-import/compose -> data-import/application, audit-platform/compose -> audit-platform/application and -> audit-platform/domain; the matching rules carry issue #2747. The new vocabulary and compose subpackages inherit their parent compose points. The production adapters in services no longer hold database, tenant-transaction or JWT logic; it lives in the owner compositions or is injected by the root as built values. The legacy composition's external suites run as internal tests. 23 of the 26 #2747 keys fall (109 -> 86 after merging development), composition surface 260 -> 259. The bun, tenant and legacy/jwt keys of services remain with the multi-owner database builders and the test hooks; services.Factory and NewFactoryWithModules stay. No route, status code, error string, table or write owner changes.
